title: Unit Event — Echo My Melody — Episode6 The Courage To Choose

meta.Event Outline: After putting on a successful show, Leo/need decides to start posting videos to a video platform so that their music can reach more people. Meanwhile, Ichika tries to help out the band by creating songs using digital tools, but is still struggling...

rows.Line: Rehearsal Studio

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (Miku and the others... They're all listening...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (Come to think of it, we haven't performed with them sitting in front of us for a fairly long time.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (They're usually stuck watching us from somewhere backstage or in the shadow of some piece of equipment...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (We never get to see their faces when we're on stage.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (But they must really enjoy themselves.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (And they've always been there for us. I mean, they helped out so much for our last show, but we never got to thank them properly...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (So... Now's our chance to do that... With our sound!)

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <I can clearly sense what they're all feeling. Maybe far more than during that last show they played...>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Me too. The way their sound is resonating with my heart... They're playing for us.>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Message received, girls.>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <And from all of us... Thank you.>

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Okay, how'd we do?!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
<Incredibly well...
Your performance really resonated with all of us, more than ever before.>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
<Yeah, I got goosebumps!
This is totally what Leo/need's all about!>

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: That's nice to hear...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <All that's left is for you girls to see how it turned out...>

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Huh?
For us to see...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Oh, right!
I totally forgot that we're making a video!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Oh, Saki... To be fair, I also nearly forgot about our primary goal, but that's a bit much.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
<Let's watch it together!
I bet it turned out super duper amazing!>

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Me too.
I'm looking forward to seeing how we did.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Whoa! This is...!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Really good...
We have so much force behind us, but it's also easy to listen to.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I think it's because we got to play for you guys, Miku.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Thank you all very much...!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Hehe. Thank you for the wonderful performance.>

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Now that I've seen this video...
I guess this is what it's like to see us play, huh...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
I'm actually a bit embarrassed.
I have such a serious expression on my face...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
No, don't say that!
You looked really cool, Hona!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Yeah, totally! It's obvious that you were playing like you meant it, which I think is really good! Sakki on the other hand couldn't contain her joy...!>

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Huh? Me?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <You do always seem to really enjoy yourself, Saki.>

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: That's an understatement. But that's also one of Saki's best qualities. It's nice how the video actually captured that.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Oh, stop it, you two.
You're making me blush... Wait!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Look, don't forget about Ichi!
The way her throat tightens up during the high notes is so cool!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Y-You don't have to examine my singing so closely...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Anyway, now that you're done shooting your video, you just have to upload it, right?>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <No, don't they have to edit it first?>

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Yes, that's right...
Can I borrow a bit more of everyone's time? We should decide on how we want our video to look.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Which is why I made sure to bring my laptop with me today...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Whoa, Hona, how did you cram so much stuff into your bag?! Is it enchanted or something?!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
It must've been heavy.
We would've helped if you needed it.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: It's actually not so bad.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Anyway, I'll send the video over to my computer and load it into my video editing software...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Hey, that's a lot easier than I expected...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <But there's so much going on with her screen. I have no idea what buttons you're supposed to push and stuff...>

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: It took me a while to get used to, but I managed to figure some things out by looking up instructions online.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
So, if you click this tab...
Oh, here. This lets you easily throw in some really cool effects.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
...!
Wow! This blur effect goes so well with our performance...!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
<That's pretty cool.
I didn't realize that one effect could change your video so much.>

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Oh, there's more. For example...
We can have flowers bloom as it plays.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Oh, that's so cute.>

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Yeah, it's cute...
But it kinda doesn't go with the video, you know?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <It's not exactly a cute and happy song either...>

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Th-This is just a test to show that we have a wide variety of options to choose from.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (A wide variety of options to choose from...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
I see...
That's quite the conundrum.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <And I have a feeling that it's going to take a while...>

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Actually, it's kind of fun to try all these different things out. Although, that was all just for practice. I'm yet to actually work on an entire video...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah, just watching you work is exciting.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
But wow Hona, you really did your homework.
You can already do so much after just starting.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I'm still limited to what a beginner can do... But if you pull this lever-like thing, you can change how the colors look...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh you're right... It looks a lot darker now.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. Isn't this fun?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: When I was at home thinking about how to edit the video, I had the idea to give it a darker tone around the chorus for a more somber feel...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: But I sort of like the original at this point. What do you all think?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Both options seem good to me.>

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Yeah, I thought the same thing.
In that case, I guess we should go with the original.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: This is just me, but I have a feeling that people are gonna focus on how dark it is instead of our song.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Wait, you think so?!
I get what you mean, Shiho, but...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
I really like this dark tone!
Like you said, Hona, it goes really well with the theme of the song...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <Looks like we've reached an impasse.>

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: What do you think, Ichika...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (Shiho and Saki both bring up valid points. Neither are wrong.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (This is just like what's going on with my own song... I need to have the courage to make a decision...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I think darker is better.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
I agree with Saki.
It makes it easier to understand what our song's about, and we wouldn't be able to do this if we weren't making a video.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yes, Shiho may be right about people focusing on that more than our song, but I don't think that's necessarily a bad thing...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: If this effect helps our viewers see how pain and sadness are at the core of this song, then I see no problem with using it.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Ichika...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, of course, Honami... You know the most about video editing here, so you'll have the final say regarding this...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Thank you.
Your suggestions have all been duly noted.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Both sides provided valid arguments, but I'm of the same mind as Ichika. I think darker is better for this song.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Since a video can't deliver the impact of a live performance 100%, I'd like to use this effect to achieve something similar.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Okay...
Maybe I gave our actual song a little too much weight.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Also, now that I think about it, not everyone who watches this video is necessarily going to be a die-hard music lover...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Which means we should probably keep them in mind if we want them to actually listen to our song. So, let's go with darker.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Okay...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Alright, now that we've reached a consensus, I'll continue working on this when I get home.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Cool! I can't wait to see how it turns out♪>

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Just from what you just showed us, Hona, I have a feeling that it's gonna turn out great!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I'm really looking forward to making even more videos♪

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Do you know what you girls are going to do for your next video?>

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yeah, a brand-new song!
I'm gonna come up with something really good for everyone who enjoys our music!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I know how you feel, but I doubt you're gonna be able to come up with one this instant.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Y-Yeah, if things go like the one before...
I'll have to think about it a lot, which means it might take a really long time...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But I know that some people out there are really looking forward to hearing our songs, so I'm gonna do everything I can to make sure our next video can bring a new Leo/need song to lots and lots of people.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (If I can write songs for us, that would directly help Leo/need...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (Until just recently, I wasn't sure when that was going to be possible, but...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (Things are different now. I have a good feeling about my song...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (I need to complete it as soon as possible, so that the others can hear it.)
